subject.title: feat(tui): inline image rendering via pi-tui Image component

question: Should TUI inline rendering read absolute MEDIA paths from the host process, or should it render only trusted structured image blocks and media-store references?
rationale: The useful feature crosses from model/tool text into local host file reads and terminal graphics output, so the permanent boundary is a maintainer product/security choice rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Render trusted structured media only
options.body: Require the implementation to use current image blocks or generated-attachment/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

options.title: Allow constrained absolute MEDIA reads
options.body: Permit host path reads only with an explicit trusted-root policy, tests, docs, and live proof for local and Docker gateway setups.

options.title: Pause under the canonical issue
options.body: Keep the feature tracked in the canonical issue while this stale draft waits for a sponsored boundary decision.

recommendation.title: Render trusted structured media only
recommendation.body: Require the implementation to use current image blocks or generated-attachment/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the image_generate flow that exposes the TUI gap and is the best available routing candidate for the product/security boundary choice.
